selection_rule: All and only layers with CE-selected versus generic rank-four replication advantage above 0.10: L1, L2, L4, L5. Decode both signs of both discovery-fitted rank-two generic-complement axes.

hypotheses.P0_selection_precedes_decoding: Layer and pole selection uses only the frozen novelty red-team fields and route/effect coordinates, never token strings.
hypotheses.P1_each_pole_has_diverse_lexical_support: Every pole has at least sixteen distinct source token IDs among its top 64 discovery examples.
hypotheses.P2_discovery_artifact_supports_frozen_la: Each pole saves contexts, source/destination/next tokens, route coordinate, residual CE effect, distance, and broad token-feature profiles for prospective labeling.
